headline: Google reports a VMware vCenter zero-day exploited; fixes exist but no workaround
plain_summary: Google says a suspected state-backed group exploited a flaw in VMware vCenter, a tool that manages virtual servers. A fix is available and there is no workaround, so administrators should patch now. CISA also lists four more exploited flaws, three due on 21 November. Cisco, NGINX and PHP also shipped important fixes. Reports on the NSA outage rule out a cyber cause, based on unnamed sources.

items.title: Google: vCenter zero-day CVE-2026-123890 exploited by ARMORY CASTLE
items.why: A confirmed unauthenticated authentication bypass in VMware vCenter has been exploited in an espionage campaign, with no workaround.
items.action: Apply the Broadcom fix (VMSA-2026-0009; e.g. vCenter 8.0 U3m) now; Broadcom lists no workaround. Restrict inbound access and egress from vCenter, and hunt with the GTIG indicators.

items.title: CISA adds four exploited flaws to KEV, three due 21 November
items.why: Synology DSM, Apache Axis and REDCap flaws have a CISA deadline of 21 November; LiteLLM is due 2 December.
items.action: Find Synology DSM, LiteLLM, Apache Axis and REDCap in your environment and apply vendor fixes where they exist. Axis 1.x is end of life with no fix (migrate or apply the July 12, 2026 commit); keep Axis, LiteLLM and REDCap off the open internet until addressed.

items.title: Cisco Expressway flaw CVE-2026-76466 exploited after public PoC
items.why: F6 reports an attack on internet-exposed clustered Expressway devices, though Cisco's advisory still says it knows of no malicious use.
items.action: If you run clustered Expressway, upgrade to X15.5.20 now (X14 and earlier must move to a fixed release; no workaround) and restrict TCP 4371-4372 to cluster peers.

items.title: F5 patches critical NGINX2Root flaws as PoC code goes public
items.why: Five critical NGINX flaws allow unauthenticated code execution; F5 does not report exploitation in the wild.
items.action: Upgrade NGINX Open Source to 1.30.7 or 1.31.9 (NGINX Plus 37.0.8.1 or 37.3.0.1) per F5's advisory K000164058, and review which affected features (HTTP/2, HTTP/3, mail proxy) you expose.

items.title: PHP security releases fix 17 flaws, several rated critical
items.why: Heise reports some allow code execution only under non-default conditions, with no exploitation in the wild.
items.action: Update PHP to 8.2.36, 8.3.37, 8.4.28 or 8.5.13 and check for the non-default configurations the advisories describe.

items.title: European Commission confirms October attack used AI tools
items.why: The Commission took some HR and staff applications offline and found no evidence of a staff-wide data breach.
items.action: Review exposure of HR and staff systems and patch internet-facing software quickly; AI tools shorten the time from flaw discovery to attack.

items.title: JPMorgan says attack on vendors may have exposed marketing data
items.why: The bank reports possible exposure of some customer names and email addresses and no service disruption; the case is still developing.
items.action: JPMorgan customers: be wary of unexpected emails that mention your account; the bank says no financial data was involved.

items.title: NSA technology outage: unnamed sources rule out a cyber cause
items.why: NBC reports the outage is ongoing and not cyber-caused, per unnamed sources; the agency has not been quoted and the cause is not stated.
